section.label: Exhibit 01
section.title: The Gallery of Her
section.lede: Every wall in this room is just an excuse to look at you a little longer. Some of these are my favorite versions. Some are just you, being you.
section.hint: Click a frame — or a name below — to look closer.

photos.title: The Smile I Keep Coming Back To
photos.caption: You didn't know I was looking. That's usually when you're most you.
photos.message: There's a version of you in this photo that I wish you could see from where I'm standing. Soft, happy, completely unaware of how pretty you are. I keep coming back to it on days I miss you.

photos.title: A Quiet Kind of Beautiful
photos.caption: No big moment. Just you, existing. Somehow that's enough.
photos.message: I like the ordinary pictures best. The ones where you're not posing or waiting for the camera. They're the closest thing I have to sitting beside you on a normal day.

photos.title: The Version of You I Adore
photos.caption: Every angle, every expression — all of them are you.
photos.message: This is one of my favorite versions of you. Not because you tried to look a certain way, but because you simply let yourself be. That is more than enough.

photos.title: The Girl Who Stole My Heart
photos.caption: Still my favorite person to look at.
photos.message: I could fill a whole museum with photos of you and still want more. This frame is for another one of the countless reasons I love you.
